themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: Reviews discussing the wood-fired or chargrilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including their flavor, freshness, size, portion count, or availability.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: Reviews discussing the fried alligator appetizer, including its texture, taste, the chili garlic aioli or mayo, and how it compares to other alligator.

themes.name: Louisiana Cochon
themes.description: Reviews discussing the signature Louisiana cochon entree of pulled pork with cabbage, cracklins and pickled peaches or turnips, including its moisture, flavor and seasoning.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: Reviews discussing the rabbit and dumplings entree, including the stew, the dumplings, the amount of rabbit meat, and its flavor.

themes.name: Smoked pork ribs
themes.description: Reviews discussing the spicy or smoked pork ribs with watermelon pickle, including tenderness, sauce, spice level and the pickled watermelon.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: Reviews discussing the braised or paneed pork cheek dishes, including tenderness, accompaniments, flavor and portion size.

themes.name: Ham hock
themes.description: Reviews discussing the smoked ham hock entree and its sides, including tenderness, saltiness and overall execution.

themes.name: Gumbo
themes.description: Reviews discussing the chicken and andouille, duck, or other gumbos, including flavor, roux, spice level, saltiness, temperature and portion.

themes.name: Boudin
themes.description: Reviews discussing the fried boudin balls, including their texture, seasoning, accompanying mustard or pickled peppers, and how they compare to other boudin.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: Reviews discussing the macaroni and cheese casserole side, including creaminess, crust, flavor and portion.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: Reviews discussing the complimentary dinner rolls and bread, including their quality, whether they were served, and refills.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Reviews discussing desserts such as the pineapple upside-down cake, chocolate pudding, pies and cakes, including quality and variety.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: Reviews discussing cocktails, beer, wine, whiskey and non-alcoholic drinks, including quality, selection, pricing and glassware.

themes.name: Server attentiveness and attitude
themes.description: Reviews discussing waitstaff and bartenders, including attentiveness, friendliness, menu knowledge, pacing, check-ins, order accuracy and handling of requests or complaints.

themes.name: Hostess and seating
themes.description: Reviews discussing the host stand, including the greeting, reservation handling, walk-in policy, seating location, table assignments and quoted wait times.

themes.name: Prices and portions
themes.description: Reviews discussing the cost of the meal relative to portion size, small plates, value for money and the bill.

themes.name: Noise and ambiance
themes.description: Reviews discussing the dining room atmosphere, including decor, noise level, lighting, temperature, seating comfort and crowding.

themes.name: Cochon Butcher comparison
themes.description: Reviews that mention the sister restaurant Cochon Butcher next door, including mix-ups between the two or preferences for one over the other.
